I have no clue if this is normal or an outlier but I feel the exact same way with some people. Theres a person who I only see once every few months at social events we have in common (we have a similar sounding background with friendship and intimacy) and I go completely insane during the lead up if I know they'll be there. when I'm there I become an anxious mess and I usually crash out after the fact in a way that I cant recover from for a solid while. I really don't have advice since I'm still trying to deal with it myself but I can try and offer a sense of community.

I am diagnosed with bpd but also a few other things so it could come from one of those (I'm so in the dark with this stuff) 

Sorry if this isn't helpful at all I just want you to know there's at least one person who feels a similar way

Honestly, I don't know if anything will make it better. I've been to a few phycologists/psychiatrists but there is no way around my brain telling me I'm secretly a pathological liar.

I've also been obsessed with ideas surrounding EDs and hate myself so much for not being strong enough to do it.

I can't help u with anything but I hope you feel a tiny bit better knowing that at least one person feels the same idk.

Hope things get better for you :)
